earliest_visible_sign.description: Transparent elongated scraped patches or window-pane areas where young larvae feed on the leaf surface.
earliest_visible_sign.shape: elongated scratch, window-like patch, fine linear scratches

characteristic_sign_or_lesion.description: Irregular elongated holes, ragged shredded whorl leaves, and sawdust-like frass inside the whorl.

colors.color_progression: Translucent window-pane to brown necrotic at dead tissue edges

shape.shape_progression: Fine linear scratches early to window-pane patches to irregular holes and ragged tears

size.size_variation_note: Size of feeding damage increases as larvae grow and leaves expand.

texture_and_surface.surface: wet or dry sawdust-like frass, missing tissue (holes/windowing)
texture_and_surface.sporulation_or_sign: presence of larvae with pale inverted Y on head; sawdust-like frass
texture_and_surface.other_surface_details: transparent window-pane patches from scraped epidermis

border_and_margin.margin_type: ragged leaf margins, irregular torn edges

advanced_or_severe_stage.description: Extensive loss of green photosynthetic tissue or leaf skeletonisation; stem, tassel, silk, and ear damage.
advanced_or_severe_stage.coalescence: Large irregular holes and torn leaf margins coalesce into extensive missing tissue.
advanced_or_severe_stage.tissue_death_appearance: Dead or torn central leaves (dead heart), heavily shredded plants.
advanced_or_severe_stage.percentage_affected_tissue_note: Extensive loss of green photosynthetic tissue or leaf skeletonisation.

distribution_on_plant.vertical_pattern: Concentrated in the central whorl and newly expanding leaves.
distribution_on_plant.horizontal_pattern: Deep in the whorl, spreading to outer leaves as larvae mature.
distribution_on_plant.other_parts_if_severe: May extend to stems, tassels, silks, ears, and kernels in later infestations.

pathognomonic_features: Window-pane feeding patches and irregular ragged holes deep in the whorl.
Presence of sawdust-like frass in the whorl and axils.
Larvae with a pale inverted Y-shaped marking on the head and four dark spots arranged in a square on the rear.
